name: Truecaller
why: Phone numbers and names are crowdsourced and often indexed publicly.

name: Justdial
why: Local business and resident listings frequently expose phone + locality.

name: IndiaMART
why: Seller profiles leak mobile numbers and city.

name: Naukri / resume indexers
why: Old resumes stay searchable with phone, email, and current city.

name: Sulekha
why: Service listings and comments often include a mobile number.

name: LinkedIn public profile
why: Employment graph is the fastest path from a handle to a real name.

name: Spokeo / US-style people search
why: If you have lived or studied abroad, these brokers reconstruct address history.

name: Intelligence X / public leak search
why: Confirms whether an email or domain appeared in public leak collections.

name: Hunter.io
why: Corporate email patterns are inferred and sold.

name: Search engines (name + city)
why: PDFs, college lists, and court cause-lists still index home addresses.
